commits.message: Require a complete BIOS mapping for cached direct reads
Fix software DMA request gating and retriggering
Bulk clear HLE RAM and revoke overwritten decoded code
fix(cpu): reject unallocated ARMv4T control encodings
Implement S3C2400 IRQ priority arbitration and rotation
Preserve callback-backed instruction fetch order and in-flight state
Invalidate decoded code after HLE EEPROM reads
Reject saved framebuffer dimensions outside fixed storage
perf(cpu): iterate selected Thumb transfer registers
Validate HLE application-query outputs with bounded RAM spans
Preserve exact live clock phases around state operations

Keep eligible x64 forward branches inside native blocks

Reuse the existing A64 straight-line target proof and count skipped operations in the saved R15 register. Preserve exact retirement on every helper and terminal exit, invalidate forwarded values at joins, and keep poll and short-budget handling intact.

Add predicate, join, callback and budget coverage, plus checked profiling and timing drivers with untaken, no-forward and cold-translation controls. GCC/Clang native timings show taken-path gains while retaining the measured translation and untaken costs for documentation.

test(arm): honor complete native BIOS mappings in fixtures

Allocate the complete BIOS window for native coverage. Keep literal data callback-backed without disabling instruction fetch, and move observable MMU tables outside the complete BIOS and RAM mappings. Preserve every native and architectural assertion.
